notesI18n.zh: 修复各平台内置更新：Windows、macOS 桌面版校验完整安装包后更新并重新打开，保留用户数据；Linux 与源码包使用独立 Node 更新进程完成编译、重启及健康检查，无需 PM2。
notesI18n.en: Fix cross-platform updates: Windows and macOS desktop apps verify and install complete release packages, relaunch and retain user data. Linux and source packages build, restart and verify health with a standalone Node supervisor, without requiring PM2.
